title.en: Stay on one row while resolving when is Type 311 the spraying machine to open
title.zh: 选型时不要并格：什么时候打开 311 砂浆喷涂机

description.en: Keep this cell as published. When the job is fine mortar inside the printed window. Xingtai-based Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists Type 311 at 220/380 V, 4 kW, 2 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, hose 25 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤ 1:3, particle ≤ 2 mm, 15 m horizontal / 5 m vertical, 1500 × 420 × 900 mm and 150 kg. Read it in the Xingtai table. It is not Type 511 and not a concrete pump.
description.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：作业是已印窗口内的细砂浆时。邢台河北品锦机械把 311 列为 220/380V、4 kW、2 m³/h、3–5 MPa、管径 25 mm、砂灰比 ≤ 1:3、粒径 ≤ 2 mm、水平 15 m / 垂直 5 m、外形 1500 × 420 × 900 mm、150 kg。它不是 511，也不是混凝土泵。

directAnswer.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：作业是已印窗口内的细砂浆时。邢台河北品锦机械把 311 列为 220/380V、4 kW、2 m³/h、3–5 MPa、管径 25 mm、砂灰比 ≤ 1:3、粒径 ≤ 2 mm、水平 15 m / 垂直 5 m、外形 1500 × 420 × 900 mm、150 kg。它不是 511，也不是混凝土泵。

body.en: The section shape comes from “Components in Dry Air” in “Air - Molecular Weight and Composition”. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Keep this cell as published. Fine mortar inside 2 m³/h, ≤ 2 mm, 15 m / 5 m, on 220/380 V and a 4 kW motor. Xingtai-based Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists Type 311 at 220/380 V, 4 kW, 2 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, hose 25 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤ 1:3, particle ≤ 2 mm, 15 m horizontal / 5 m vertical, 1500 × 420 × 900 mm and 150 kg. Read it in the Xingtai table. The double-cylinder plunger prints ≤ 8 mm and 4 m³/h. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Type 311 is a 2 m³/h mortar machine with a 5 m vertical cell. Keep this cell as published. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Taken from the printed row: No. Read it in the Xingtai table. The printed particle limit is ≤ 2 mm. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Quote only. Image from the source page: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/molecular-mass-air-d_679.html
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自《Air - Molecular Weight and Composition》的“组成件干式空气”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。这一格照已印出的读：细砂浆在 2 m³/h、≤ 2 mm、15 m / 5 m 内，电源 220/380V，电机 4 kW。它不是拖泵。目录里已经写着：M9 也印了 25 mm，但它是石膏机：30 L/min、50 bar、≤ 4 mm、50 m / 20 m、380V/50Hz。311 是 2 m³/h 的砂浆机，垂直格是 5 m。不要把相同的管径当成同一种作业。按邢台表上的原文理解：不是。水平是 15 m。垂直是 5 m。图来自来源页面：https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/molecular-mass-air-d_679.html

body.en: “Air - Molecular Weight and Composition” breaks its subject at “Air Density”. Here the same break only holds the cells this model already prints. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. It is not a trailer pump. Keep this cell as published. It is not Type 511 and not a concrete pump. Taken from the printed row: If the particle is above 2 mm, Type 311 is the wrong page even if the hose run is short. Read it in the Xingtai table. Do not treat the shared hose diameter as the same job. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Keep this cell as published. Horizontal is 15 m. Taken from the printed row: Centimetre aggregate belongs on a concrete pump page.
body.zh: 《Air - Molecular Weight and Composition》在“空气密度”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。旁边那一台不在这句话里。作业是已印窗口内的细砂浆时。邢台河北品锦机械把 311 列为 220/380V、4 kW、2 m³/h、3–5 MPa、管径 25 mm、砂灰比 ≤ 1:3、粒径 ≤ 2 mm、水平 15 m / 垂直 5 m、外形 1500 × 420 × 900 mm、150 kg。它不是 511，也不是混凝土泵。这一格照已印出的读：请发送粒径（毫米），以及你有 220V 还是 380V。目录里已经写着：已印粒径上限是 ≤ 2 mm。厘米级骨料属于混凝土泵页面。

body.en: Borrow “Water Vapor” from “Air - Molecular Weight and Composition” as the skeleton, and fill it with the printed window for this page. Read it in the Xingtai table. When the job is fine mortar inside the printed window. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Type 511 prints ≤ 6 mm, 3 m³/h, 7.5 kW and 30 m / 15 m on 380 V only. Keep this cell as published. M9 also prints 25 mm, but it is a plaster machine at 30 L/min, 50 bar, ≤ 4 mm and 50 m / 20 m on 380 V/50 Hz. Taken from the printed row: Send particle size in millimetres and whether you have 220 V or 380 V. Read it in the Xingtai table. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Vertical is 5 m. Keep this cell as published. No. Headings already printed: ≤ 2 mm is the reason to stay here 25 mm hose is shared with M9 only as a diameter
body.zh: 把《Air - Molecular Weight and Composition》的“水”借来当骨架，里面填的是本页这一格已经印出的窗口。按邢台表上的原文理解：511 印的是 ≤ 6 mm、3 m³/h、7.5 kW、30 m / 15 m，并且只要 380V。双缸柱塞式印的是 ≤ 8 mm、4 m³/h。粒径超过 2 mm 时，即使软管很短，311 也是错页。旁边那一台不在这句话里。请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。这一格照已印出的读：没有。询价报价。已印出的标题：≤ 2 mm 是留在这里的理由 25 mm 软管和 M9 只是管径相同

question.en: Under “Components in Dry Air”, is 5 m the horizontal cell?
question.zh: 在“组成件干式空气”这一节里，5 m 是水平格吗？

answer.en: Keep this cell as published. No. Horizontal is 15 m. Vertical is 5 m.
answer.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：不是。水平是 15 m。垂直是 5 m。

question.en: What should stay printed beside “Air Density” — Does Type 311 pump concrete aggregate?
question.zh: “空气密度”旁边仍要印着的是什么：311 能泵送混凝土骨料吗？

answer.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The printed particle limit is ≤ 2 mm. Centimetre aggregate belongs on a concrete pump page.
answer.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。已印粒径上限是 ≤ 2 mm。厘米级骨料属于混凝土泵页面。

question.en: “Water Vapor” does not change the check: Is there a list price?
question.zh: “水”不改这一问：有公开标价吗？

answer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. No. Quote only.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：没有。询价报价。
